svg.title: Booking, payment and errors

g.text: Paid and free paths, sold out during checkout, declined card, and unknown payment result.
No payment row · CTA Reserve spot
Saved card and email are masked
Payment is not sent · say why
Say Not charged only if verified
Ask provider before a new payment
No real transaction, hold or refund is claimed.
Not charged appears only after verification.
An unknown result never triggers a second charge.
Maximum is 3 because 3 spots are left.
2 tickets: total and button read 36 JOD.

svg.text: Fictional test content. Scarcity counts, saved card and payment results are invented for this assignment.
